content.title: 'The Masked Singer' Season 14 Semifinalists: See All the Clues Revealed So Far
content.text: NEED TO KNOW The Masked Singer season 14 semifinals air on March 25Pugcasso, Crane, Galaxy Girl, Pangolin and Cat Witch are the five contestants left in the competitionCat Witch's identity has already been revealed to viewers at home, but the judges are still guessing The semifinals for The Masked Singer season 14 are here, which means the glamorous guessing game is gearing up for an epic showdown. The latest installment of the singing competition series has been a weekly star-studded affair, with celebrities like Tiffany Haddish, Taraji P. Henson, Billy Ray Cyrus, Heidi Montag and more getting unmasked onstage. The Masked Singer season 14 finale airs on April 1, but before that, the five remaining entertainers — Pugcasso, Crane, Galaxy Girl, Pangolin and Cat Witch — have to try to secure a spot in the last round. A preview for the semifinals teases the TV event as "four powerhouse women versus one lone pug" in "five knockout performances." Here are all the clues revealed so far about The Masked Singer season 14 semifinalists. Pangolin Pangolin on 'The Masked Singer'. Trae Patton/FOX Pangolin revealed she grew up in a place "rich with American history" and was raised in a sports-obsessed family. She said she later became "the half-time queen." "Turns out my sports-obsessed roots fueled my competitive fire," Pangolin said in a clip of clues. Visual hints have included an astronaut leading a marching band, a football stadium, a kettle bell with a heart on it, a tip jar and the number 1,000. Jenny McCarthy thought Pangolin was Christina Perri, but her theory was debunked when the singer made an appearance on the show, delivering a "Colossal Clue." "She's not me, and I'm not her — but Pangolin and I do love a girls' night out together, and I can't wait for the next one," Perri said, putting the rumors to rest. Crane Crane on 'The Masked Singer'. Trae Patton/FOX On "Clueless Night," Crane said, “The ’90s literally represent everything I do, and I do it all — whether it’s primetime, film or billions of streams.” Whoever is underneath the Crane costume has "crossed wings" with other major celebrities, like Janet Jackson, Michelle Obama and Angelina Jolie. Meanwhile, visual clues for Crane have comprised of a construction helmet, a nutcracker, a jar of sugar, a large diamond and origami cranes. During "Spice Girls Night," Crane revealed that Mel B has been a mentor to her, taking her under her wing. Crane is not Ashanti, as Robin Thicke kept guessing, and her "Colossal Clue" was a football player proposing on one knee. “I just kicked off my next chapter with a major win. And I couldn’t be happier," Crane said. Galaxy Girl Galaxy Girl on 'The Masked Singer'. Trae Patton/FOX Galaxy Girl was a successful child star who "walked away" from the spotlight. A "Welcome 2 LA" sign, a heart-shaped rock, a tear-away calendar with Friday the 13th circled, a clock set to 10:10 and a record titled Dream have been some of the visual clues for Galaxy Girl's identity. "I know firsthand when you spend your life in front of cameras, people try to control your every move, especially as a woman," Galaxy Girl said in a video where she is seated behind a news desk. She continued, "They try to tell you what to wear. The night before one of the biggest shoots of my life, I changed my whole look and I didn't tell anybody. The shoot went global. Oh, and my look iconic." For her "Colossal Clue," Galaxy Girl confirmed she has a connection to Las Vegas, but is not Gwen Stefani. Pugcasso Pugcasso on 'The Masked Singer'. Trae Patton/ FOX Before fame found him, Pugcasso was "supposed to take over the family business," but his life changed "overnight" after he won a major competition. Visual clues have included a statue of Big Ben, a Hawaiian shirt, a gold first-place trophy, a baseball home plate and a sign that read, "Warning: Maximum Capacity 132 Million." Other hints have been a sign that says "Bye, bye, bye" and a matchbox. For his "Colossal Clue," an Olympic torch was brought onstage, teasing a possible link between the pup and the international athletic event. Cat Witch Cat Witch on 'The Masked Singer'. Michael Becker/FOX Cat Witch's identity is still a mystery to the panel of judges, but viewers know the fierce feline is Descendants: The Rise of Red star Kylie Cantrall. Cat Witch was introduced as "America's Insider," giving behind-the-scenes access to the at-home audience. Hints that have been dropped about Cat Witch involve a red spell book, a spells cauldron, a can of soda pop and having her own best-selling action figure.
